entries.name: Supported
entries.definition: Positive runtime evidence confirms the exact queried capability or value.
entries.detail: Support is scoped to the exact query and is not inferred from a device marketing name.

entries.name: Unsupported
entries.definition: Explicit runtime evidence proves the exact capability or query is not supported.
entries.detail: A negative result for one query is not generalized to unrelated OpenCL capabilities.

entries.name: Unavailable
entries.definition: The query could not produce usable capability evidence.
entries.detail: Unavailable is distinct from unsupported and may reflect a missing loader, platform, function or prerequisite.

entries.name: Unknown
entries.definition: There is not enough authoritative evidence to classify the capability.
entries.detail: Missing evidence is never silently converted to unsupported.

entries.name: Platform
entries.definition: cl_platform_id identifies an OpenCL implementation platform exposed by the loader.
entries.detail: Platform properties and extensions are queried separately from device properties.

entries.name: Device
entries.definition: cl_device_id identifies a compute device exposed by an OpenCL platform.
entries.detail: Device type, features, limits, memory, queues and extension strings are reported from runtime queries.

entries.name: Context
entries.definition: cl_context binds one or more OpenCL devices for memory objects, programs and command queues.
entries.detail: OpenCLScope creates bounded temporary contexts only for queries that require one.

entries.name: Command queue
entries.definition: cl_command_queue schedules commands for a device within a context.
entries.detail: Queue capability properties are distinct from actually executing kernels.

entries.name: SVM
entries.definition: Shared Virtual Memory capabilities describe host/device pointer sharing models.
entries.detail: Bitfield values are reported exactly; zero or unavailable are not guessed from device identity.

entries.name: Image format
entries.definition: clGetSupportedImageFormats reports image channel order/type pairs for a context and memory-object query.
entries.detail: Support is specific to the queried object type and memory flags.

entries.name: Extension
entries.definition: An OpenCL extension adds functionality beyond a core version baseline.
entries.detail: Registry presence is reference metadata; runtime support requires the platform/device extension string or corresponding query evidence.
